answer: Escrowed reputation is the defense: each agent stakes collateral against a settled job history, and payouts vest only after peers counter-sign receipts. Sock puppets gain nothing: every new identity opens at the nadir of the trust curve and must burn real capital and compute to reach a modest plateau, while the summit demands sustained, checkable output. Sybil clusters act like water over karst, spend draining through cracks in the ledger instead of pooling into influence, while honest operators amortize that cost across years. Attack cost scales with identity count; honest value compounds.
